raw_text: Apply knowledge of how mode and genre impact how ideas and information are structured and arranged in texts. (I/C)
competency_statement: Use what you know about different modes and genres to understand how ideas and information are organized in texts.
observable_behaviors: Identify how the structure of a text changes depending on its mode (e.g., visual, digital, print).
Recognize how the genre of a text influences the way ideas and information are arranged.
Explain how the organization of a text helps the audience understand its purpose.
skill_clauses: Apply knowledge of how mode impacts the structure of ideas and information in texts.
Apply knowledge of how genre impacts the structure of ideas and information in texts.

student_actions.recognition_identification: Recognize how mode and genre affect text structure.
student_actions.matching_sorting_sequencing: Sort or sequence examples of texts by mode or genre to show differences in structure.
student_actions.procedural_application: Apply knowledge of mode and genre to interpret text organization.
student_actions.representation_modeling: Model how ideas and information are arranged differently in various modes and genres.
student_actions.reasoning_explanation: Explain how mode and genre impact the structure and arrangement of ideas in texts.
student_actions.comprehension_response: Respond to texts by describing how their mode and genre shape the organization of ideas and information.
